name: 14-bored-watch
prompt: Close-up of a bored executive's wrist as he checks his luxury watch under a stiff banquet table's cold lighting, his face out of focus behind, sense of wasted time. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
